main.description: A fairness-bot verdict on a reply, published alongside the callout reply it triggered.

reply.description: The bot's own callout reply, posted in response to the subject.

score.description: How fairly the subject engaged, from 0 (pure hostility, no substance) to 100 (fully fair and evidence-based).

reasoning.description: The judge's explanation for the score.

replyText.description: The exact text of the bot's callout reply.
